title: Lead - Data API

ActionCadenceAssigneeId.description: The ID of the sales rep designated to work the lead through their assigned cadence. This field is available in API version 48.0 and later when the Sales Engagement license is enabled. To see this field, the user also needs the Sales Engagement User or Sales Engagement Quick Cadence Creator user permission set.

ActionCadenceId.description: The ID of the lead’s assigned cadence. This field is available in API version 48.0 and later when the Sales Engagement license is enabled. To see this field, the user also needs the Sales Engagement User or Sales Engagement Quick Cadence Creator user permission set.

ActionCadenceState.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
ActionCadenceState.description: The state of the current action cadence tracker. This field is available in API version 50.0 and later when the Sales Engagement license is enabled. To see this field, the user also needs the Sales Engagement User or Sales Engagement Quick Cadence Creator user permission set. Possible values are: Complete Error Initializing Paused Processing Running

ActiveTrackerCount.description: The number of cadences that are actively running on this lead. This field is available in API version 57.0 and later when the Sales Engagement license is enabled. To see this field, the user also needs the Sales Engagement User or Sales Engagement Quick Cadence Creator user permission set.

ActivityMetricId.description: When Einstein Activity Capture with Activity Metrics is enabled, the ID of the related activity metric. This field is a relationship field. This field is available in API version 41.0 and later.

ActivityMetricRollupId.description: When Einstein Activity Capture with Activity Metrics is enabled, the ID of the related activity metric rollup. This field is a relationship field. This field is available in API version 41.0 and later.

Address.description: The compound form of the address. Read-only. For details on compound address fields, see Address Compound Fields.

AnnualRevenue.description: Annual revenue for the lead’s company.

City.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

CleanStatus.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
CleanStatus.description: Indicates the record's clean status compared with Data.com. .Several values for CleanStatus appear with different labels on the lead record. Values include: Acknowledged - Reviewed Different Inactive Matched - In Sync NotFound - Not Found Pending - Not Compared SelectMatch - Select Match Skipped

Company.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Company.description: The lead’s company. If person account record types have been enabled, and if the value of Company is null, the lead converts to a person account.

CompanyDunsNumber.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
CompanyDunsNumber.description: The Data Universal Numbering System (D-U-N-S) number, which is a unique, nine-digit number assigned to every business location in the Dun & Bradstreet database that has a unique, separate, and distinct operation. Industries and companies use D-U-N-S numbers as a global standard for business identification and tracking. Maximum size is 9 characters.This field is only available to organizations that use Data.com Prospector or Data.com Clean.

ConvertedAccountId.description: Object reference ID that points to the account into which the lead converted. This is a relationship field.

ConvertedContactId.description: Object reference ID that points to the contact into which the lead converted. This is a relationship field.

ConvertedDate.description: Date on which this lead was converted.

ConvertedOpportunityId.description: Object reference ID that points to the opportunity into which the lead has been converted. This is a relationship field.

ConnectionReceivedId.description: ID of the PartnerNetworkConnection that shared this record with your org. This field is available when Salesforce to Salesforce is enabled.

ConnectionSentId.description: ID of the PartnerNetworkConnection that this record is shared with. This field is available Salesforce to Salesforce is enabled. In API version 16.0 and later, this value is null. Use PartnerNetworkRecordConnection object to forward records to connections.

Country.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

CountryCode.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
CountryCode.description: The ISO country code for the lead’s address.

CurrencyIsoCode.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
CurrencyIsoCode.description: Available only for organizations with the multicurrency feature enabled. Contains the ISO code for any currency allowed by the organization.

DandBCompanyId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
DandBCompanyId.description: Reference ID to a Dun & Bradstreet® company record, associated with an account added from Data.com.

Division.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Division.description: A logical segment of your organization's data. For example, if your company is organized into different business units, you could create a division for each business unit, such as North America, Healthcare, or Consulting. Available only when the Division permission is enabled.

Email.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Nillable, Sort, Update

EmailBouncedDate.description: If bounce management is activated and an email sent to the lead bounced, the date and time of the bounce. Email bounce functionality isn't triggered by record updates, including updates to this field.

EmailBouncedReason.description: If bounce management is activated and an email sent to the lead bounced, the reason for the bounce. Email bounce functionality isn't triggered by record updates, including updates to this field.

ExportStatus.description: Derived field for the record map for Partner Connect. The export status of this opportunity to the partner’s connected org. To see this field, enable Partner Connect and add the Export Vendor Records to an Authorized Partner Org user permission to the cosell export user. See Set Up Partner Connect as a Vendor in Salesforce Help. Available in API version 62.0 and later.

Fax.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

FirstCallDateTime.description: The date and time of the first call placed to the lead. This field is available in API version 48.0 when the Sales Engagement license is enabled. To see this field, the user also needs the Sales Engagement User or Sales Engagement Quick Cadence Creator user permission set.

FirstEmailDateTime.description: The date and time of the first email sent to the lead. This field is available in API version 48.0 when the Sales Engagement license is enabled. To see this field, the user also needs the Sales Engagement User or Sales Engagement Quick Cadence Creator user permission set.

FirstName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
FirstName.description: The lead’s first name up to 40 characters.

GeocodeAccuracy.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
GeocodeAccuracy.description: Accuracy level of the geocode for the address. For details on geolocation compound fields, see Compound Field Considerations and Limitations.

GenderIdentity.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
GenderIdentity.description: The lead’s internal experience of their gender, which may or may not correspond to their designated sex at birth.

HasOptedOutOfEmail.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Update
HasOptedOutOfEmail.description: Indicates whether the lead doesn’t want to receive email from Salesforce (true) or does (false). Label is Email Opt Out.

HasOptedOutOfFax.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
HasOptedOutOfFax.description: Indicates whether the lead doesn’t want to receive faxes from Salesforce (true) or does (false). Label is FaxOpt Out.

IndividualId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
IndividualId.description: ID of the data privacy record associated with this lead. This field is available if you enabled Data Protection and Privacy in Setup.

Industry.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Industry.description: Industry in which the lead works.

IsConverted.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
IsConverted.description: Indicates whether the lead has been converted (true) or not (false). Label is Converted.

IsDeleted.description: Indicates whether the object has been moved to the Recycle Bin (true) or not (false). Label is Deleted.

IsPriorityRecord.description: Shows whether the user has marked the lead as important (True) or not (False). The default value is false. Available in API version 59.0 and later.

IsUnreadByOwner.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsUnreadByOwner.description: If true, lead has been assigned, but not yet viewed. See Unread Leads for more information. Label is Unread By Owner.

Jigsaw.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Jigsaw.description: References the ID of a contact in Data.com. If a lead has a value in this field, it means that a contact was imported as a lead from Data.com. If the contact (converted to a lead) wasn’t imported from Data.com, the field value is null. Maximum size is 20 characters. Available in API version 22.0 and later. Label is Data.com Key. Important: The Jigsaw field is exposed in the API to support troubleshooting for import errors and reimporting of corrected data. Don’t modify the value in the Jigsaw field.

JigsawContactId.description: The ID of the contact in reference to Jigsaw. Important: The Jigsaw field is exposed in the API to support troubleshooting for import errors and reimporting of corrected data. Don’t modify the value in the Jigsaw field.

LastActivityDate.description: Value is the most recent of either: Due date of the most recent event logged against the record. Due date of the most recently closed task associated with the record.

LastName.description: Last name of the lead up to 80 characters.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record indirectly, for example, through a list view or related record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, the user might have only accessed this record or list view (LastReferencedDate) but not viewed it.

Latitude.description: Used with Longitude to specify the precise geolocation of an address. Acceptable values are numbers between –90 and 90 up to 15 decimal places. For details on geolocation compound fields, see Compound Field Considerations and Limitations

LeadSource.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
LeadSource.description: The origin or source of the lead.

Longitude.description: Used with Latitude to specify the precise geolocation of an address. Acceptable values are numbers between –180 and 180 up to 15 decimal places. For details on geolocation compound fields, see Compound Field Considerations and Limitations.

MasterRecordId.description: If this record was deleted as the result of a merge, this field contains the ID of the record that was kept. If this record was deleted for any other reason, or hasn’t been deleted, the value is null.When using Apex triggers to determine which record was deleted in a merge event, this field’s value is the ID of the record that remains in Trigger.old. In Trigger.new, the value is null. This is a relationship field.

MiddleName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
MiddleName.description: The lead’s middle name. Maximum size is 40 characters.

MobilePhone.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

Name.description: Concatenation of FirstName, MiddleName, LastName, and Suffix up to 203 characters, including whitespaces.

NumberOfEmployees.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
NumberOfEmployees.description: Number of employees at the lead’s company. Label is Employees.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: ID of the lead’s owner. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

PartnerAccountId.description: ID of the partner account for the partner user that owns this lead. Available if Partner Relationship Management is enabled or if digital experiences is enabled and you have partner portal licenses. In API version 16.0 and later, the Partner Account field is set to the appropriate account for the partner user that owns the lead. If the owner of the lead isn’t a partner user, this field has no value.

Phone.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

PostalCode.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
PostalCode.description: Postal code for the address of the lead. Label is Zip/Postal Code.

Pronouns.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Pronouns.description: The lead’s personal pronouns, reflecting their gender identity. Others can use these pronouns to refer to the lead in the third person. The entry is selected from a picklist of available values, which the administrator sets. Maximum 40 characters. Possible values are: He/Him He/They Not Listed She/Her She/They They/Them

Rating.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

RecordTypeId.description: ID of the record type assigned to this object.

Salutation.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

ScheduledResumeDateTime.description: The date and time when the action cadence tracker is going to resume after it’s paused or on a wait step. This field is available in API version 54.0 and later when the Sales Engagement license is enabled. To see this field, the user also needs the Sales Engagement User or Sales Engagement Quick Cadence Creator user permission set.

ScoreIntelligenceId.description: The ID of the intelligent field record that contains lead score.

State.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
State.description: State for the address of the lead.

StateCode.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
StateCode.description: The ISO state code for the lead’s address.

Status.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
Status.description: Status code for this converted lead. Status codes are defined in Status and represented in the API by the LeadStatus object.

Street.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Street.description: Street number and name for the address of the lead.

Suffix.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Suffix.description: The lead’s name suffix. Maximum size is 40 characters.

Title.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Title.description: Title for the lead, such as CFO or CEO. The maximum size is 128 characters. When converting a lead to a person account, the conversion fails if the lead Title field contains more than 80 characters.

Website.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

usage:
If lead data is imported and you need to set the value for an audit field, such as CreatedDate, contact Salesforce Support. Audit fields are automatically updated during API operations unless you request to set these fields yourself. To update a lead or to convert one with convertLead(), log in to your client application with the Edit permission on leads.

If lead data is imported and you need to set the value for an audit field, such as CreatedDate, contact Salesforce Support. Audit fields are automatically updated during API operations unless you request to set these fields yourself.

To update a lead or to convert one with convertLead(), log in to your client application with the Edit permission on leads.
associated_objects:
This object has these associated objects. If the API version isn’t specified, they’re available in the same API versions as this object. Otherwise, they’re available in the specified API version and later.

- **LeadChangeEvent (API version 44.0)**: Change events are available for the object.
- **LeadFeed (API version 18.0)**: Feed tracking is available for the object.
- **LeadHistory**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
- **LeadOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **LeadShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
